text.tspan: "The member product needs its middleware integration layer realized on Eclipse S-CORE so that the Autoware-based AEBS stack consumes the reference vehicle speed over S-CORE and the HMI in the AAOS SDV guest shows the AEBS state, while the emergency intervention command path stays on the host."
"The S-CORE services start on the Linux host and the vehicle-speed provider publishes the reference vehicle speed."

"Autoware consumes the reference vehicle speed through S-CORE, the HMI presents the AEBS state with per-field provenance and degrades fail-closed when its source is stale or unavailable, and the emergency command path is unaffected by the middleware or the guest."
Operate the AEBS member across its two execution domains without
selecting transport, schema or application technology, and without
any safety, compliance or driver-warning claim for the HMI.
